text_block_list.text: Gold City dropped modeling career. Put work into practice today too... yet something felt off.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Speed died out on final stretch again. What's the deal here...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Even ditched modeling to pick this road...! Trainer! Ramp up practice menu!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What nonsense? Can still push—
choice_data_list: A change of pace is also important!
A change of pace is also important!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with that scary face... Fine, break time. Just need rest, happy?!
Strolling downtown on day off, caught sight of Gold City at open terrace cafe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
Gold City swiped through smartphone blankly. Tried slipping away quietly, but got called out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Think I wouldn't spot you? Lurking around leaking that pushy aura.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: This? Ah... just checking old photos.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Logs of workouts and diets. Plus... shots from photo shoots. Rest doesn't matter anymore anyway.
choice_data_list: It must be an important memory
It must be an important memory

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not really? Wiped them already. Laser-focused on debut race!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Times still aren't improving though... Totally at loss here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever, today's for clearing head! Tagging along with me. With that strict manager face, annoying pick-up guys won't bug me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Listen up, though! Don't act like some chaperone. Shut up and follow.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What a boring movie...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tons of my favorite brands around... but none of it really grabs me... Ugh.
No matter where we went, Gold City barely reacted...
Suddenly, Gold City stopped. She was staring straight at a massive advertising billboard.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah...! No way. It's totally normal for ads to catch your eye. But man, seeing it like this hits different.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: The second you quit, the next girl replaces you instantly. You stop, you get left behind, buried in the past...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whatever, it's fine. Can't believe that's me on camera... Just some dumb fake image, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm exhausted.
Gold City abruptly stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Say something. You've got something on your mind, don't you? You've been giving off that vibe all day.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Just shut it... Not another passionate lecture. I'm not lost or anything. I already threw that past away.
choice_data_list: And the pictures in your phone?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What's this about? What are you saying? Why does what's on my phone even matter right now?
choice_data_list: You had precious memories of your work or something, right?
You had precious memories of your work or something, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...?! Are... are you stupid or what?! Fine, I'll delete them right now! All I care about is running!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll just wipe them clean right here, right now! I don't need any of it anyway!
Gold City pulled out her smartphone and opened the photo album.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: These photos...! So annoying...! Seriously...
choice_data_list: Can I see them for a moment?
Can I see them for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't peek!... Well, whatever. Just a quick glance won't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...This was the first day I ever appeared on TV. Look how try-hard my face was... so ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: This was my first commercial shoot. People praised it a lot. And this... first time I cried over messing up... Don't look! Forget it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And this... the first time I took a picture with a fan. She told me her dream was to become a designer and dress me in her clothes...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: None of them are virtual images

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Shut up! Just don't say anything stupid! I'm deleting every single one!
Her slender fingers flew across the screen, selecting every photo. Then, hovering over delete—
Gold City's fingers froze.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why... I already made up my mind to throw it all away... If I don't, I won't ever run right again...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So why... why does it keep flashing back while I run...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Even during practice! While running! It feels like there's a gaping hole in my chest... I can't let it go...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Just let me throw it away... Please, just let me get rid of it...!
choice_data_list: You don’t have to abandon yourself
You don’t have to abandon yourself

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, ahaha... idiot. That's the second time you've said that... Don't keep repeating yourself, dummy. I don't even know anymore...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No way...! I just can't do it...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...?! What is it now? I'm set on this! Are you really going to be my partner or what? You're confusing me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Look at you! Lending a hand, tearing it down! Stop being so damn difficult already...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Idiot. Idiot, dummy, moron. Stubborn, clumsy, mean jerk.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah... seriously, what is your deal? Ahaha... My trainer, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if there really is a way to do both.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Right. Guess we should try finding a way before giving up entirely...
choice_data_list: Let’s take one step at a time and find the answer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Dummy. Shouldn't I just run and look for answers along the way?... Ah. First, I need to apologize to the agency.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Just picturing it makes me laugh. You're offering to apologize for me, even though I caused all the drama?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I appreciate the thought... but I have to go myself. And tell them straight up: from now on, I'm modeling and racing with these legs!
